page.overview:
Who is Destin R d'Oraguille?

King Destin R d'Oraguille is a non-playable Elvaan character in Final Fantasy XI. He is the King of San d'Oria and father of Prince Trion, Prince Pieuje, and Princess Claidie. Destin is involved in many parts of the San d'Oria Missions.

;He is involved in the following missions:

Destin appears in Final Fantasy Trading Card Game as Lightning-elemental Backup cards.
